title: Coordinated design of manifolds and branch channels for improving flow distribution and temperature uniformity in PEM water electrolyzers
scope: CFD and constrained geometric optimization; no experimental or machine-learning replacement
objective: Area-weighted standard deviation of temperature on the ACL/PEM interface, K (Eq.27)
constraint: abs(Acontact/Aref - 1) <= delta (Eq.29), all nine widths within 0.7..1.5 mm, positive ribs
algorithm: COBYLA; uniform 1 mm initial widths; relative objective change < 1e-5

Membrane conductivity closure, ionomer fraction and dissolved-water boundary/source laws
eta_lambda and dimensions of Eq.17; rho_i/EW is also present in Eq.16
